content: Rev. 8 reorganization completed: both phases get orchestrators (host_phase.go, chroot_phase.go), main.go simplified to 2 calls. New chrootPhase files: boot.go, storage.go, logging.go, misc.go, network.go. Reduced services.go to only runlevels. Merged dmcrypt→zswap. Renamed functions. Removed enableEncryption bug. Deleted 7 old files. All 5 binaries compile, go vet clean.

Sessione completa: riorganizzazione cartelle (hostPhase/internal, chrootPhase/internal, chrootPhase/internal/features), lint pulito (go vet + golangci-lint), rimossi alias bash, aggiunto ensureIncusAdminGroup, ridotta verbosita firmware, log piu leggibili. Harness 25/25. Tutti i binari compilano.
